info.title: Gateway Service
info.description: Single entry point for all OnePlatform external traffic. Handles outbound webhook subscriptions, Server-Sent Event streams, dynamic entity data routing, and tenant rate-limit configuration. All other /api/v1/* paths are transparently proxied to the appropriate upstream service.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: OpenAPI spec endpoints. Serve the pre-built merged spec and, for authenticated requests, a tenant-specific overlay with concrete entity paths.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Outbound webhook subscriptions. The platform delivers events to registered URLs with HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Server-Sent Event stream for real-time tenant-scoped event delivery.

tags.name: Data
tags.description: Dynamic entity data proxy. Routes requests to the Ingestion service for any entity type defined in the tenant's ontology.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Rate limit configuration. Requires the admin scope (platform-admin role only).

get.description: When called with a valid Bearer token, returns the platform OpenAPI spec merged with auto-generated paths for the requesting tenant's ontology entity types. Without authentication, returns the static base spec with generic templated data paths. `op sdk generate` calls this endpoint with the stored Bearer token to receive the full tenant-specific spec.
